overview_description.description:
G42 is an artificial intelligence (AI) and cloud computing company that provides solutions in various industries. G42’s platforms and industry solutions harness the latest scientific research and apply it in responsible ways. 

G42 is driving change in the region and beyond, joining forces with nations, corporations, and individuals to create the infrastructure for tomorrow’s world – with technology that goes beyond to give its partners the edge. From molecular medicine to space travel and everything in between, G42 realizes exponential possibilities, today.

about_short_description.short_description: G42 is an artificial intelligence (AI) and cloud computing company that provides solutions in various industries.

product.name: The Intelligence Grid
product.description: An integrated AI infrastructure framework connecting compute, cloud, data centers, connectivity, data, and industry-specific AI solutions for national and enterprise-scale deployments.

product.name: AI Cloud and Computing Services
product.description: Cloud and accelerated-computing services for developing, training, deploying, and scaling AI applications, including enterprise and sovereign workloads.

product.name: Data Center Infrastructure
product.description: Secure, scalable data center infrastructure that hosts cloud services, AI computing, and enterprise workloads for public- and private-sector customers.

product.name: Applied AI and Analytics
product.description: AI and analytics platforms that turn complex operational data into insights, forecasts, and decisions for governments, enterprises, and industry operators.

product.name: AI Security and Cybersecurity Services
product.description: Cybersecurity solutions for protecting digital infrastructure, data, applications, and connected environments against cyber threats and operational risks.

product.name: Generative AI Models and Platforms
product.description: Large language models, agentic AI, and domain-specific AI platforms for natural-language interaction, automation, knowledge work, and enterprise applications.
